data.label: Louie B. Nunn Center for Oral History
data.description: SPOKEdb Oral History Collection Management System currently provides access to 19892 interview records, and 765 projects.

data.label: Notable Kentucky African Americans Database
data.description: Discover information about African Americans with Kentucky roots and ties, including people, places, and events, along with sources for further research.

data.label: Lexington Herald-Leader photographs
data.description: Explore photographs from the Lexington Herald-Leader documenting 20th century Lexington, including the people, places, events, and changes that shaped the city and surrounding region.

data.label: University of Kentucky Libraries Microfilm Holdings database
data.description: Search UK Libraries’ microfilm master negatives, including newspapers, manuscript collections, and other primary source materials.

data.label: Kentucky Digital Newspaper Program
data.description: Browse nearly one million pages of historical and contemporary Kentucky newspapers across more than 260 titles, including digitized and born-digital content, with options to search by title, location, and genre.

data.label: The Lomax Kentucky Recordings
data.description: Listen to documentary recordings of rural Kentucky music and folklore collected between 1933 and 1942 through the Archive of American Folk Song at the Library of Congress.

data.label: The John G. Heyburn II Initiative for Excellence in the Federal Judiciary
data.description: Explore archival collections and oral history interviews documenting Kentuckians who have served in the federal judiciary and their contributions to American legal discourse.

data.label: The University of Kentucky Libraries Web Archives
data.description: Explore archived websites, social media posts, and other web-based documents from UK and the Commonwealth.
